purpose: Report which finished Dyk work is merged, still held, or ready to close.

authorization.grantedBy: owner (netbka), delegated to the owner's main session
authorization.text: On 2026-10-10 the owner directed: 'resume work. The agents should never stop working. You know the goal. No my review is needed.' This campaign takes netbka/Dyk#458 and #405 only, as report-only close-out research. No code, branch, PR, label or issue-state change; reports are posted by the supervisor. No production, Docker, SQL, live providers or browsers. One worker; never merge or deploy. No run cap or cost ceiling; provider subscription limits and the no-progress guard are the stops. Provider order Claude, then Codex, then Cursor.

constraints: Report-only campaign for netbka/Dyk#458 and #405, authorized 2026-10-10. Do not change files, branches, PRs, labels or issue state; do not comment yourself. The supervisor posts the verified report.
Use read-only gh commands and the repository at current main. No production access, Docker, SQL Server, live providers, browser tests, paid services or deploys.
Never read private conversations, real user data, .env contents or credentials.
Cite every claim with a PR/issue number, merge SHA or comment timestamp. State unknowns instead of inferring, and never claim visual, SQL or live acceptance that did not happen.
